options: A happiness is the most elusive of goals.
Happiness is the most elusive of goals.
The happiness is the most elusive of goals.
An happiness is the most elusive of goals.
questions.explanation: Abstract 'happiness' takes no article in a general statement.
When an abstract noun is specified by an of-phrase, the definite article is used.
'Life' in the general sense takes no article; 'the life' would mean a specific life.
Abstract nouns modified by an adjective still take no article in general statements.
'A' is used when 'knowledge' is particularised as a specific body or kind of knowledge.

questions.explanation: In general statements, uncountable abstract nouns take the zero article.

Beauty of the Taj Mahal is breathtaking.
Some beauty of the Taj Mahal is breathtaking.
The beauty of the Taj Mahal is breathtaking.

With abstract nouns, 'a' marks one instance or type of the quality.

options: A silence that followed was deafening.

The silence that followed was deafening.

options: A death comes to us all.
The death comes to us all.
Some death comes to us all.
questions.explanation: Abstract 'death' in general takes no article; 'the death' would refer to a specific death.
